# AI Code Review & Security Auditor ⚡

## 📋 Commercial Job Reference
- **Platform Source:** Malt Commercial Job Listing (Freelance Mission)
- **Client Need:** Fintech / Web3 company requiring automated static code analysis, vulnerability scanner, and AI code review assistant.
- **Estimated Market Price:** 4,500 €
- **Average TJM (Daily Rate):** 750 € / day (6 days duration)

## 🚀 Key Features
- Static code security scanner (detects hardcoded keys, eval calls, weak regex, unsanitized innerHTML).
- Instant AI refactoring suggestions.
- Code quality score calculation.

## ⚡ Bolt Performance Optimizations
- **Linear Stream Tokenizer:** Uses O(N) line-by-line regex scanning instead of heavy AST parsing, ensuring instantaneous audits even on large code snippets.
- **Immediate Visual Feedback:** Zero re-renders during code input typing.
